fee_notes: Royalty: 3-12% of Gross Revenue depending on products sold and tenure. Brand Fund (regional/national advertising): 1-3% tiered by annual revenue, reduced to 2% on revenue exceeding $1M. Local Advertising: 6% of Gross Revenue (or $1,200 minimum) in year 1, then 4-3% tiered. Opening advertising $5,500. Interest on late payments: lesser of 18% or max legal rate. Convention fees currently $0 (up to $500 possible). Per diem assistance $400/day. Operations manual copies $1/page.
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fee is between 3% and 12% of Gross Revenue, depending on the products and services sold and how long an AMRAMP® Business has operated in the territory. Brand Fund: 1% (if <$300k annual gross revenue), 2% (if $300k-$500k), 3% (if ≥$500k), reduced to 2% on revenue >$1M. Local Advertising: 6% of Gross Revenue or $1,200 (whichever greater) in year 1, then 4% (if $300k-$500k) or 3% (if ≥$500k).
